newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.014pts to 103.246.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.014pts to 103.246.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.014 points in Friday's trading to 103.246, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.246 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, remained unchanged at 99.556 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.185 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.500 points to 1,034.518.
